substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Contractor states mechanically attached systems reduce installation time and cost; no technical equivalence justification provided for the 45 mil thickness or attachment change.

substitutions_proposed.spec_item: R-30 polyiso in two staggered layers (RFP §3.1 / included items)
substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Contractor states single-layer insulation 'meets code requirements while minimizing material costs'; does not address thermal bridging at butt joints which the RFP two-layer staggered stack is designed to prevent.

substitutions_proposed.spec_item: Tapered insulation or added drains to resolve ponding (RFP scope)
substitutions_proposed.substitute_offered: No ponding correction; offered as upgrade only
substitutions_proposed.equivalence_justification: Contractor disputes the RFP's ponding finding based on own site visit.

warranty_offered.evidence_page: Cover letter, Warranty section + Attachments list

technical_approach.narrative: Bid proposes mechanically attached 45 mil TPO over single-layer R-30 polyiso, no cover board. Phased work committed generically ('work in sections to minimize disruption') without detail on staging, dry-in, or tenant coordination. Temporary weather protection and after-hours HVAC coordination explicitly excluded.
technical_approach.tear_off_staging_plan: Generic: 'complete the roof in sections to minimize disruption... expose only necessary areas at one time.' No phase sizes, dumpster plan, or staging zones stated. Conflicts with RFP §3.1 phasing requirement (max 15,000 sqft exposed, watertight at EOD).
technical_approach.weather_protection_plan: Explicitly excluded ('Temporary weather protection for incomplete phases' listed as exclusion #12).
technical_approach.fall_protection_plan: Generic safety program statement: 'Fall protection training for all workers.' No site-specific anchor plan, parapet strategy, or CSA Z91 reference.
technical_approach.waste_disposal_plan: Not described beyond 'Roof removal and disposal $85,000' line item; no recycling or environmental plan.

wsib_clearance.evidence: COI section + Attachments list: 'WSIB Account #1234567-89'; 'WSIB Clearance Certificate attached'. Online re-verification at clearances.wsib.ca will be added as a standard award condition by the recommendation memo step.
wsib_clearance.notes: Certificate date not printed in the bid body; per roof-qualification-check SKILL.md §1, pass the gate and defer online verification to award conditions rather than block compliance on a check the owner can perform in 30 seconds.

cgl_insurance.evidence: Insurance section: 'Commercial General Liability: $5,000,000 per occurrence' — meets RFP §5.1.2 ($5M minimum). However, bid does not confirm (a) Tenebrus Capital is named as Additional Insured, (b) 2-year completed-operations tail, or (c) that 'Lakeside Roofing Inc.' is the named insured on the COI. RFP requires all three (rfp.mandatory_requirements).
cgl_insurance.notes: Limit is compliant; three line items require COI review before award. Not a fail because the COI is attached and the owner can inspect it directly.

bonding.evidence: RFP §9.2 requires 50% performance and 50% L&M bonds; while RFP does not set a bid bond percent, no bid bond, consent of surety, or declared bonding capacity appears in the submission. Attachments list contains no surety documents.
bonding.notes: Performance + L&M bond consent should accompany the bid. Absent surety consent is a material compliance gap on a ~$488k project.

working_at_heights_training.evidence: Safety Program section: 'Fall protection training for all workers.' Interpreted as confirmation of O. Reg. 297/13 WAH training per fixture 04 §3.
working_at_heights_training.notes: Language is generic; confirm current (3-yr validity) certificates at award.

addenda_acknowledgment.evidence: No Form of Tender or addenda acknowledgment section appears in the markdown submission. RFP requires explicit acknowledgment (rfp.mandatory_requirements.addenda_acknowledgment_required = true).
addenda_acknowledgment.notes: Unknown whether any addenda were issued; if so, acknowledgment is missing. Owner to confirm.

non_collusion_declaration.evidence: No signed non-collusion declaration is reproduced in the bid markdown. Cover letter is signed by Tony Marchetti, President, but RFP requires a separate non-collusion declaration (rfp.mandatory_requirements.non_collusion_declaration_required = true).
non_collusion_declaration.notes: May exist in an attached package; if not in the physical submission it is a fail.

minimum_years_in_business.evidence: Cover letter: 'Lakeside Roofing has been serving the Greater Toronto Area for 12 years.' Exceeds RFP §5.1.3 10-year minimum.

similar_project_references.evidence: Three references provided (Maple Logistics 62k sqft 2024; Westpark Industrial 71k sqft 2023; Torque Distribution 55k sqft 2025) — all commercial low-slope and within last 5 yrs, meeting count = 3 per RFP §5.1.4. However, project values are not stated, so the comparable test (0.5x-2x subject value, roof-qualification-check Gate 8) cannot be confirmed.
similar_project_references.notes: Square footage is broadly in family (~55-71k vs 85k subject). Values needed to close the comparable test.

site_visit.evidence: Cover letter: 'We attended the mandatory site visit on March 25, 2026.' Satisfies RFP §6.4 / §8.1.

red_flags.description: 45 mil TPO proposed where RFP specifies 60 mil minimum — below commercial single-ply industry minimum.
red_flags.citation: RFP §3.1 '60 mil minimum'; fixture 02 §1 (60 mil is commercial TPO minimum)
red_flags.evidence: Key Specifications: 'Membrane: 45 mil TPO, mechanically attached'; Price Breakdown: 'TPO membrane (45 mil) $145,000'

red_flags.description: No cover board included over polyiso insulation. Missing cover board is a critical defect for commercial TPO over polyiso and voids most manufacturer system warranties.
red_flags.citation: Fixture 02 §4 (missing cover board = critical red flag); RFP included_items '1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso cover board'
red_flags.evidence: Price Breakdown has no cover board line; Key Specifications list only membrane, insulation, attachment; contractor does not mention cover board anywhere.

red_flags.description: 15-year material-only warranty offered vs RFP-required 20-year total-system NDL. Shortfall on both duration (15<20) and tier (material_only vs total_system_ndl).
red_flags.citation: RFP §3.1, §9.6 (20-year minimum, total-system NDL); fixture 02 §1 and §4.5 warranty taxonomy
red_flags.evidence: Warranty section: 'Manufacturer Warranty: 15-year limited warranty on TPO membrane'; Attachments list: 'Sample 15-Year Warranty Documentation'.

red_flags.description: Mechanically attached system proposed where RFP specifies fully-adhered attachment. Change in attachment method materially alters wind-uplift performance and voids the specified system.
red_flags.evidence: Key Specifications: 'Attachment: Mechanically attached system'; Additional Notes: 'We use efficient mechanically attached systems that reduce installation time and cost.'

red_flags.description: Ponding correction (tapered insulation or added drains) deleted from base bid and offered only as an upgrade; contractor disputes RFP ponding finding on self-assessment.
red_flags.citation: RFP included_items 'Tapered insulation or added drains to resolve ponding'
red_flags.evidence: Exclusion #10: 'Tapered insulation for ponding correction - available as upgrade'; Additional Notes: 'our inspection did not confirm significant ponding... proceeding with standard installation'.

red_flags.description: Temporary weather protection for incomplete phases explicitly excluded on an occupied 85,000 sqft pharma-warehouse with phased tear-off. Creates water-ingress hazard to occupants and products.
red_flags.citation: RFP §3.1 phasing 'watertight at EOD'; fixture 01 §3 (site safety on occupied buildings)
red_flags.evidence: Exclusion #12: 'Temporary weather protection for incomplete phases'.

red_flags.description: No site-specific fall protection / anchor plan provided; only a generic 'fall protection training' statement. Occupied commercial roof requires CSA Z91 anchor plan and parapet strategy.
red_flags.evidence: Safety Program section lists training and weekly meetings only; no site safety plan attached (Attachments list).

red_flags.description: Wind uplift design basis not stated. Commercial low-slope TPO with mechanical attachment on a 28-year-old deck requires documented CSA A123.21 or FM 1-29 design.
red_flags.evidence: No wind uplift design reference anywhere in the bid; product data sheets listed but no design calcs.

red_flags.description: Single-layer R-30 polyiso proposed vs RFP-specified two staggered layers. Single-layer stacks create thermal bridging at butt joints and may not satisfy SB-10 effective R-value at seams.
red_flags.citation: Fixture 01 §1.3 (SB-10 effective R-value); RFP included_items 'R-30 polyiso in two staggered layers'
red_flags.evidence: Key Specifications: 'Insulation: Polyisocyanurate, R-30 (single layer to meet code minimum)'; Additional Notes: 'Single-layer insulation meets code requirements while minimizing material costs.'

red_flags.description: After-hours HVAC coordination and temperature monitoring excluded on an occupied pharma-warehouse that requires 72-hour HVAC shutdown coordination per RFP.
red_flags.citation: RFP included_items 'HVAC temporary protection, 72-hr shutdown coordination'
red_flags.evidence: Exclusions #13 'Temperature monitoring of warehouse during construction' and #14 'After-hours HVAC coordination'.

red_flags.description: No manufacturer named and no certified installer program declared. 20-yr NDL system warranties require certified installer status at the named tier (e.g., Soprema PAQ+S, Firestone Red Shield Platinum, GAF Master Elite).
red_flags.evidence: Materials section names no manufacturer; attachments list does not include a manufacturer certification letter.

red_flags.description: No bid bond, consent of surety, or declared bonding capacity. RFP §9.2 requires 50% performance and 50% L&M bonds; bid should include surety consent.
red_flags.evidence: Attachments list contains no surety documents; no bonding capacity stated anywhere.

red_flags.description: COI does not confirm Tenebrus Capital named as Additional Insured or 2-year completed-operations tail; named insured entity on COI not verified against bidder legal name.
red_flags.evidence: Insurance section lists $5M CGL only; no AI endorsement or completed-ops language reproduced in submission.

red_flags.description: No subcontracting disclosure. RFP projects of this scope typically require declaration of whether roofing crew is in-house or sub'd, and naming of key subs. Undisclosed sub-trades on the actual roofing crew is a fixture 04 §5 shell-company signal.
red_flags.evidence: No subcontractor list in the bid.

red_flags.description: Reference project values not provided; comparable-reference test (0.5x-2x subject value, last 5 yrs, same building class) cannot be fully evaluated.
red_flags.evidence: References section lists square footage and year but not contract value.

red_flags.description: Non-collusion declaration and addenda acknowledgment not reproduced in submission. RFP requires both as mandatory.
red_flags.evidence: Markdown submission contains cover letter signed by president but no separate non-collusion form or addenda acknowledgment page.

extraction_notes: HST treatment explicit: $487,500 before HST + $63,375 HST = $550,875 including HST. Base bid recorded as pre-HST per convention; hst_included=false.
No manufacturer named in the bid (only 'TPO membrane') — cannot identify warranty program. Product data sheets claimed as attached but not in the markdown file. Owner follow-up needed.
Reference project contract values not stated — cannot confirm 0.5x-2x subject-value comparable test for Gate 8. Owner to request values from the three named references.
Bid bond / consent of surety / bonding capacity completely absent from submission. Attachments list has no surety documents. Owner follow-up needed.
COI details (additional insured endorsement, completed-ops tail, named insured legal entity) not reproduced in markdown; need to inspect physical COI attachment.
Non-collusion declaration and addenda acknowledgment not reproduced; may exist in physical submission package — confirm before scoring.
Crew size, mobilization days, named foreman not stated — schedule sub-factors cannot be fully evaluated.
WSIB clearance date not printed in bid body; per qualification-check SKILL.md §1 the gate still passes pending online re-verification at award.
Certification program (Soprema PAQ+S, GAF Master Elite, Firestone Red Shield Platinum, etc.) not declared; required to qualify for any 20-yr NDL system warranty.
No C of Q Skilled Trades roofer count declared.

sub_factors.name: Tear-off & staging
sub_factors.rationale: Generic 'work in sections' language; no phase sizes, dumpster plan, or staging zones. Conflicts with RFP §3.1 15k sqft cap.

sub_factors.name: Weather protection / dry-in
sub_factors.rationale: Temporary weather protection for incomplete phases explicitly excluded (Exclusion #12).

sub_factors.name: Fall protection & safety
sub_factors.rationale: Generic 'fall protection training' statement only; no site-specific anchor plan or CSA Z91 reference; no site safety plan attached.

sub_factors.name: Waste / environmental / logistics
sub_factors.rationale: Disposal line item ($85,000 roof removal) present, but no recycling, environmental, or logistics plan.

sub_factors.name: Quality control / inspection protocol
sub_factors.rationale: No QC checkpoints, manufacturer inspections, or final walk-through protocol described.

technical_approach.summary: Generic narrative with no phasing detail, explicitly excludes weather protection, generic safety language, minimal waste plan, and no QC protocol.

sub_factors.name: Warranty type (vs RFP requirement)
sub_factors.rationale: Material-only warranty (tier 20); RFP requires total_system_ndl.

sub_factors.name: Warranty years vs RFP minimum
sub_factors.rationale: 15-year manufacturer warranty; RFP minimum is 20 years — below minimum.

sub_factors.name: Installer certification at claimed warranty tier
sub_factors.rationale: No manufacturer named and no certified installer program declared.

sub_factors.name: Workmanship warranty years
sub_factors.rationale: 2-year workmanship warranty falls in the 2-4 year band.

sub_factors.name: Materials quality (thickness, cover board, premium line)
sub_factors.rationale: 45 mil TPO (below 60 mil commercial minimum) and no cover board included — below industry standard.

warranty_materials.summary: 15-yr material-only warranty vs RFP 20-yr total-system NDL; 45 mil TPO with no cover board and no named manufacturer / certified installer — materially deficient.

sub_factors.name: Count of comparable references (Gate 8 definition)
sub_factors.rationale: Three references provided (Maple 2024, Westpark 2023, Torque 2025) all commercial low-slope within 5 yrs; sqft 55-71k vs 85k subject is broadly in family. Project values not provided, so 0.5x-2x value test cannot be confirmed — treated as 1-2 comparable until values clarified.

sub_factors.name: Recency of most-recent comparable reference
sub_factors.rationale: Torque Distribution, Vaughan completed 2025 — within 1 year of bid.

sub_factors.name: Verifiability
sub_factors.rationale: Each reference has named contact + phone + year + sqft, but contract value missing on all three — partial.

experience_references.summary: Three similar-scope commercial references across last three years; contract values missing blocks full Gate 8 comparable confirmation.

sub_factors.name: Years in business
sub_factors.rationale: 12 years in business (10-14 year band).

sub_factors.name: Manufacturer certification at or above warranty tier claimed
sub_factors.rationale: No manufacturer named; no certified installer program declared (e.g., Soprema PAQ+S, GAF Master Elite).

sub_factors.name: Skilled Trades C of Q crew
sub_factors.rationale: No C of Q Skilled Trades roofer count declared; foreman not named.

sub_factors.name: Industry membership
sub_factors.rationale: Not a CRCA member; no regional/provincial roofing association membership declared.

qualifications_certifications.summary: 12 years in business satisfies tenure; no manufacturer certification, no C of Q crew declared, no CRCA or regional membership.

sub_factors.name: Timeline realism vs scope
sub_factors.rationale: 75-day duration (May 1 - July 15 2026) is realistic for 85k sqft tear-off/replace by a single crew, but no phase sequencing or milestones provided.

sub_factors.name: Crew adequacy
sub_factors.rationale: Crew size not stated; no foreman named.

sub_factors.name: Mobilization and completion dates vs RFP
sub_factors.rationale: Substantial completion date (July 15 2026) stated and meets RFP window; mobilization days after award not stated.

sub_factors.name: Occupied-building accommodation
sub_factors.rationale: accommodates_occupied_building=false; bid excludes temporary weather protection, after-hours HVAC coordination, and warehouse temperature monitoring — no tenant-coordination plan.

schedule.summary: Realistic 75-day duration hitting substantial completion, but crew size undisclosed, no mobilization date, and no occupied-building coordination plan.

strengths: 12 years in business with three recent similar-scope GTA commercial references (2023-2025) meeting the count floor.
WSIB clearance and $5M CGL attached; mandatory site visit attended.
Substantial completion date committed (July 15, 2026) within RFP window.
weaknesses: Materially non-compliant technical system: 45 mil mechanically attached TPO, no cover board, single-layer R-30, no ponding correction — voids the specified system and most NDL warranties.
15-year material-only warranty (vs RFP 20-yr total-system NDL), no manufacturer named, no certified installer program, and no bid bond/surety consent.
scoring_rationale.differentiator: Lowest apparent price is achieved by deleting RFP scope (cover board, 60 mil membrane, fully-adhered attachment, ponding correction, weather protection, HVAC coordination) — price advantage is not like-for-like.
